Title: How clear is the main point?
Detail_lesson: Could a reader say it back in one sentence?
ClaudeNote: If the average is under 4, rewrite the opening before anything else.

Title: How long should it be?
Detail_lesson: Think of the time the reader will give it.
Options: One page|Two or three pages|Longer, with sections
ClaudeNote: Fit the document to the winning length, cutting or splitting as needed.

Title: Would you send this as it is?
Detail_lesson: To the person it is for, today.
ClaudeNote: Put this score and its top reason in the wrap-up summary.
